fields.hero_text: Panels, inverters, lithium batteries, water pumps and complete solar packages for homes and businesses, designed to help you cut your fuel bills.
fields.about_text:
Chamboko Solar Technology is a wholly owned Zimbabwean company dedicated to bringing light and hope to every home through high-quality solar energy solutions.

We supply solar panels, power and hybrid inverters, lithium batteries, solar water pumps, solar lighting systems and solar fridges for residential and commercial use.
fields.meta_description: Solar panels, inverters, lithium batteries, water pumps and complete solar packages in Harare. Request a quote from Chamboko Solar Technology.
